Effects, one at a time

Pick a song and press play, then switch one effect on at a time and choose the part it goes on: Light, Medium or Heavy against Off, which is the dry part, matched in loudness so louder never wins. Space plays and pauses, the keys A, S, D and F are Off, Light, Medium and Heavy on the effect you last touched, and when you have marked them keep, cut or unsure, Copy link at the bottom and text it back.

Listen to
Copy the link and text it back, done or not. Your marks are in it.
